SELECT 'g1' grp, main_cat, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(prc) prc_ct FROM items_g1 GROUP BY main_cat
UNION ALL SELECT 'g2', main_cat, COUNT(*), COUNT(prc) FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat
UNION ALL SELECT 'g3', main_cat, COUNT(*), COUNT(prc) FROM items_g3 GROUP BY main_cat
ORDER BY grp, n DESC;

SELECT 'g2' grp, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(prc) prc_ct, COUNT(prc_usd) usd_ct, MIN(prc) min_prc, MAX(prc) max_prc, MIN(prc_usd) min_usd, MAX(prc_usd) max_usd, AVG(prc) avg_prc, AVG(prc_usd) avg_usd FROM items_g2;
SELECT ref_id, prc, prc_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL LIMIT 20;
SELECT COUNT(prc_usd) AS priced_products, ROUND(AVG(prc_usd), 4) AS avg_price_usd FROM items_g2 WHERE prc_usd IS NOT NULL;
SELECT SUM(prc <> prc_usd*100) AS mismatches, COUNT(*) AS both_present FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL;
SELECT ref_id, prc, prc_usd, prc/100.0 AS cents_if, ROUND(prc_usd*100-prc,2) AS diff FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND prc <> prc_usd*100 LIMIT 25;
SELECT MIN(prc), MAX(prc) FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL AND prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND prc <> prc_usd*100;
